title: Calloway Homeowner Credit on Builder Extended Rate Lock Relocks
content:
A buyer who already owns, or has owned, a Calloway home covered by the Calloway Limited Home Warranty receives a credit against the relock fee percent of a Builder Extended Rate Lock.

**Rule.** A buyer who holds a Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage in status active on another home takes 0.0625 percentage points off the relock fee percent; a buyer whose Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage on record is transferred or expired takes 0.03125 percentage points off; any other buyer takes nothing off. The points are taken off the relock fee percent before that percent is applied to the loan amount on the lock.

## Credit by warranty coverage status

| The buyer's Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage | Taken off the relock fee percent |
|---|---|
| in status active, on another home | 0.0625 percentage points |
| on record in status transferred or expired | 0.03125 percentage points |
| none of the above | nothing |

## Points of judgement

- The status is read from the buyer's Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage record, not from the buyer's description of the home.
- An active coverage counts when it is on another home than the one the lock finances.

**Hypothetical effect.** A relock fee percent of 0.375 for a buyer holding an active coverage on another home becomes 0.3125 before it is applied to the loan amount.
